lines.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 농부가 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.

lines.text: 농부는 밭을 열심히 갈았어요. 농부를 톡톡톡 눌러서 밭을 갈아 봐요!
lines.en: The farmer worked hard in his field. Tap, tap, tap the farmer to dig!

lines.text: 농부를 톡톡톡! 괭이질을 해요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the farmer! Dig with the hoe.

lines.text: 쨍! 괭이 끝에 뭔가 딱딱한 게 닿았어요.
lines.en: Clang! The hoe hit something hard.

lines.text: 땅속에서 둥근 뚜껑이 보여요. 농부를 톡톡톡 눌러서 힘껏 당겨 봐요!
lines.en: A round lid is showing in the ground. Tap, tap, tap the farmer to pull it out!

lines.text: 농부를 톡톡톡! 영차 당겨요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the farmer! Heave-ho, pull!

lines.text: 쑥! 커다란 항아리가 나왔어요. 농부는 눈이 동그래졌어요.
lines.en: Pop! A big jar came out. The farmer's eyes went wide.

lines.text: 농부는 항아리를 집 마당에 놓았어요. 아내도 구경하러 나왔어요.
lines.en: The farmer put the jar in his yard. His wife came out to look, too.

lines.text: 농부가 괭이를 항아리 옆에 두려다 그만 항아리 속에 떨어뜨렸어요. 괭이를 톡!
lines.en: The farmer tried to put his hoe beside the jar, but it fell inside. Tap the hoe!

lines.text: 괭이를 톡! 항아리에 넣어요.
lines.en: Tap the hoe! Put it in the jar.

lines.text: "어머나! 괭이가 두 개가 되었어요!" 아내가 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: Oh my! There are two hoes now! His wife was so surprised.
segs: Oh my! There are two hoes now!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡 눌러서 괭이가 몇 개 나오는지 세어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the jar and count how many hoes come out!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡! 괭이를 세어 봐요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the hoes.

lines.text: 괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
lines.en: One, two, three hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.

lines.text: 이번에는 엽전 하나를 넣어 봤어요. 와르르! 엽전이 쏟아져 나왔어요.
lines.en: This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 다섯 개 세어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap the jar five times and count five coins!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the coins.

lines.text: 엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.

lines.text: 착한 농부는 혼자만 쓰지 않았어요. 이웃 다섯 집에 쌀을 나눠 주러 갔어요.
lines.en: The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.

lines.text: 집을 톡! 쌀을 나눠 줘요.
lines.en: Tap a house! Share the rice.

lines.text: 다섯 집 모두 쌀을 받고 활짝 웃었어요. 마을이 함께 행복해졌어요.
lines.en: All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.

lines.text: 소문을 들은 부잣집 주인이 농부를 불렀어요. "그 항아리를 나한테 빌려주게!"
lines.en: A rich man heard the news and called the farmer. Lend me that jar!
segs: A rich man heard the news and called the farmer.

lines.text: 마음씨 착한 농부는 웃으며 말했어요. "필요하시면 쓰세요. 잘 쓰고 돌려주세요!" 항아리를 톡!
lines.en: The kind farmer said with a smile. Please use it, and bring it back! Tap the jar!
segs: The kind farmer said with a smile.
Please use it, and bring it back!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡! 부자에게 빌려줘요.
lines.en: Tap the jar! Lend it to the rich man.

lines.text: "고맙네! 얼른 가져가야지, 헤헤." 부자는 항아리를 꼭 안고 달려갔어요.
lines.en: Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee. The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.
segs: Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee.
The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.

lines.text: 부자는 방에 항아리를 놓고 말했어요. "금덩이를 넣으면 금이 산더미가 되겠지!"
lines.en: The rich man put the jar in his room. If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!
segs: The rich man put the jar in his room.
If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡 눌러서 금덩이를 넣어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the jar to put in the gold!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡! 금덩이가 나와요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the jar! Gold bars come out.

lines.text: 금덩이가 와르르! 부자는 금 더미에 폭 파묻혔어요. "사람 살려~"
lines.en: Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold. Help me!
segs: Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold.

lines.text: 부자를 톡! 눌러서 꺼내 줘요.
lines.en: Tap the rich man to pull him out.

lines.text: 부자를 톡! 금 더미에서 꺼내 줘요.
lines.en: Tap the rich man! Pull him out of the gold.

lines.text: 쏙! 부자가 빠져나왔어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
lines.en: Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.

lines.text: 그때 부자의 아버지가 다가와 항아리 속을 들여다보았어요. "이게 뭐냐?"
lines.en: Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar. What is this?
segs: Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar.

lines.text: 아버지를 톡! 눌러서 항아리 쪽으로 가 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the father to walk toward the jar.

lines.text: 아버지를 톡! 항아리를 구경해요.
lines.en: Tap the father! Look at the jar.

lines.text: 풍덩! 아버지가 항아리에 거꾸로 쏙 빠졌어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
lines.en: Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.

lines.text: "아버지가 어디 계시지?" 항아리를 톡톡톡 눌러서 아버지를 세어 봐요!
lines.en: Where is Father? Tap, tap, tap the jar and count the fathers!
segs: Tap, tap, tap the jar and count the fathers!

lines.text: 항아리를 톡톡톡! 아버지를 세어 봐요.
lines.en: Tap, tap, tap the jar! Count the fathers.

lines.text: 아버지가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 여덟 명이나 되었어요.
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.

lines.text: "내가 진짜 아버지다!" "아니야, 내가 진짜야!" 모두 서로 자기가 진짜라고 우겼어요.
lines.en: I am the real father! No, I am the real one! Each one insisted he was the real father.
segs: No, I am the real one!
Each one insisted he was the real father.

lines.text: "배고프다! 밥 줘라!" 부자는 쟁반을 들고 이리저리 뛰어다녔어요.
lines.en: I am hungry! Give me food! The rich man ran around with a tray.
segs: I am hungry! Give me food!
The rich man ran around with a tray.

lines.text: 부자는 지쳐서 외쳤어요. "이게 다 항아리 때문이야! 이제 그만!" 부자를 톡!
lines.en: The rich man was worn out and shouted. It is all because of this jar! Stop! Tap the rich man!
segs: The rich man was worn out and shouted.
It is all because of this jar! Stop!

lines.text: 부자를 톡! 항아리를 그만 쓰자고 해요.
lines.en: Tap the rich man! Say, no more jar.

lines.text: 쨍그랑! 항아리가 깨지자 일곱 명은 사라지고, 진짜 아버지만 남았어요.
lines.en: Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.

lines.text: "아버지, 죄송해요. 욕심을 부려서 소동이 났어요."
lines.en: Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.
segs: Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.

lines.text: 부자는 농부를 찾아가 사과하고, 가진 것을 마을 사람들과 나누기로 했어요. 함께 잔치를 열어요!
lines.en: The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!

lines.text: 상을 톡! 맛있는 음식을 차려요.
lines.en: Tap the table! Set out yummy food.

lines.text: "모두 고맙네!" 모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.
lines.en: Thank you, everyone! They all sat together and ate happily.
segs: They all sat together and ate happily.

lines.text: 농부를 톡! 모두 함께 만세!
lines.en: Tap the farmer! Hooray, everyone!

lines.text: 나누면 기쁨이 커져요. 요술 항아리 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.
lines.en: Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
